scanNote:
11-BET. Unit 1 — tanishtirish, o'qituvchilar profili.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 18-mashq (5 gap pufakchasi), 19-mashq (o'yin), 20-mashq (4 profil), Writing va Words of Wisdom.

⚠ 18-MAShQ — IKKI SURAT, IKKI VAZIYAT:
  A — RASMIY tanishtirish (uchinchi odam tanishtiradi): 'Mr Potter, this is Mr Jackson.' → 'Pleased to meet you.' → 'Pleased to meet you, TOO.'
  B — O'ZINI tanishtirish: 'Hello! I'm Frank Smith. What's your name?' → 'I'm Gillian Jones, but please call me Gill.'
  ⚠ 'TOO' so'zi javob ekanini bildiradi — shuning uchun u IKKINChI pufakchada.
  ⚠ 'please call me Gill' — to'liq ism Gillian, qisqasi Gill. Inglizlarda bu odatiy: Robert→Bob, William→Bill, Elizabeth→Liz.

⚠⚠ 20-MAShQ — AUDIO KERAK: to'rt o'qituvchidan faqat MARY STUART ning yoshi (30) kitobda berilgan. John Parry va Bob Davisning yoshi faqat kassetada aytiladi; Rashid Al Hibb haqida esa namuna gap yo'q.
  ⚠ Bu — audio hisobotidagi ro'yxatda qayd etilgan (CB 11 Ex.20).
  ⚠ Ilovada bu bandlar ogohlantirish bilan ko'rsatiladi, jimgina tashlab ketilmaydi.

⚠ MA'LUMOT: Rashid Al Hibb — Iskandariya (Misr); Mary Stuart — Dublin (Irlandiya); John Parry — Glazgo (Shotlandiya); Bob Davis — Sonsi (Uels).
  ⚠ To'rt shahar to'rt xil mamlakat/o'lkadan — Britaniyaning uch qismi (Irlandiya, Shotlandiya, Uels) va Misr.

⚠ MAQOL: 'A stranger is a friend you haven't met yet.' = Notanish odam — bu shunchaki hali tanishmagan do'sting.

pairsWith.noteUz: Muloqot (tanishtirish) bo'limi workbook 7-betdagi Communication mashqlariga mos keladi. Grammatika kitobida bu mavzu yo'q — alohida qoladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Write the sentences in the correct speech bubbles, then listen and check. Finally, act out the dialogues.
exercises.instructionUz: Gaplarni to'g'ri gap pufakchalariga yozing, so'ng eshitib tekshiring. Nihoyat, dialoglarni sahnalashtiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
Ikki xil vaziyat:
A) RASMIY — uchinchi shaxsni tanishtirish. 'Mr Potter, this is Mr Jackson.' Familiya oldidan Mr/Mrs/Ms ishlatiladi.
B) NORASMIY — o'zini tanishtirish. 'please call me Gill' — to'liq ismini aytib, keyin qisqasini so'raydi (Gillian → Gill).
Javob har doim '..., too' bilan qaytariladi.

exercises.instructionEn: Work in two teams. Take it in turns to choose words from the list and make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point. The team with the most points is the winner.
exercises.instructionUz: Ikki jamoaga bo'linib ishlang. Navbat bilan ro'yxatdan so'z tanlab, gap tuzing. Har to'g'ri gap 1 ball. Ko'p ball to'plagan jamoa g'olib.
exercises.explanationUz:
Bu Unit 1 ning butun lug'atini takrorlash o'yini. Ilovada siz bir jamoa bo'lasiz — so'z beriladi, siz gap tuzasiz.
Har so'zga mos qolip:
• musician, job, capital → 'X is a musician' (a/an kerak)
• years old → 'He's forty years old'
• where → 'Where is he from?'
• married, pleased → sifat, a/an olmaydi
exercises.example: Team A S1: Fergus is a musician.

modelSentences.sentence: Cairo is the capital of Egypt.

exercises.audioRequiredUz: Yoshlar audio'dan eshitiladi — kitob bilan birga keladigan yozuv kerak.
exercises.instructionEn: Listen and fill in the missing information, then talk about some of the teachers who work at Mortimer College, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Eshiting va yetishmayotgan ma'lumotni to'ldiring, so'ng Mortimer kollejida ishlaydigan o'qituvchilar haqida namunadagidek gapiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har profil 4 qismdan iborat: ism → shahar, mamlakat → yosh → kasb.
Gapirganda shu tartibda 3 ta gap tuziladi:
1) This is + ISM.
2) He's/She's from + SHAHAR, MAMLAKAT.
3) He's/She's + YOSH + years old and he's/she's + a/an + KASB.
Diqqat: 'an English teacher' (unli), 'a Maths teacher' (undosh).
exercises.example: This is Mary Stuart. She's from Dublin, Ireland. She's thirty years old and she's an English teacher at Mortimer College.
exercises.exampleUz: Bu Mary Stuart. U Dublindan, Irlandiyadan. U o'ttiz yoshda va Mortimer kollejida ingliz tili o'qituvchisi.

exercises.instructionEn: You are a foreign student at Mortimer College. You are responsible for the college magazine and this is the first page of the first issue. Introduce yourself to the readers. Start with: Hello! I'm ... . Then, introduce some of the teachers who work at the college. Start with: This is ... . He/She is ... . Use the information from Ex. 20 and the pictures from the Photo File section, as well as a picture of yourself.
exercises.instructionUz: Siz Mortimer kollejida chet ellik talabasiz. Kollej jurnaliga mas'ulsiz va bu birinchi sonning birinchi sahifasi. O'zingizni tanishtiring: 'Hello! I'm ...'. So'ng kollejda ishlaydigan o'qituvchilarni tanishtiring: 'This is ... . He/She is ...'.
exercises.explanationUz:
Ikki qismli yozma ish:
1) O'ZINGIZ haqingizda — birinchi shaxsda (I'm ...)
2) BOSHQALAR haqida — uchinchi shaxsda (He's/She's ...)
Qolip bir xil: ism → qayerdan → yosh → kasb.
Eng ko'p xato: uchinchi shaxsda 's' ni unutish va a/an ni tushirib qoldirish.

exercises.instructionEn: Read this sentence. What does it mean?
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gapni o'qing. U nimani anglatadi?
exercises.sentenceEn: A stranger is a friend you haven't met yet.
exercises.sentenceUz: Notanish odam — bu siz hali uchrashmagan do'stingiz.
exercises.explanationUz:
Ma'nosi: har bir notanish odam kelajakdagi do'st bo'lishi mumkin — shuning uchun tanishishdan qo'rqmang. Unit 1 mavzusiga (tanishuv) mos hikmat.
Grammatik jihatdan: 'you haven't met yet' — Present Perfect, keyingi darslarda o'rganiladi. Hozircha ma'nosini tushunish yetarli.

wordFormation.introUz: Bu sahifadagi ism qisqartmalari va fan nomlari.

groups.explanationUz: Ingliz tilida ismlarning qisqa (erkalash) shakli keng tarqalgan. 'Please call me ...' iborasi bilan aytiladi.
O'qituvchi kasbi 'FAN + teacher' shaklida aytiladi. Artikl FAN nomining tovushiga qarab tanlanadi:
Buyuk Britaniya 4 qismdan iborat — har birining o'z millat nomi bor.

sentencePatterns.introUz: Odam haqida gapirishning to'liq qolipi — Unit 1 ning yakuniy ko'nikmasi.

patterns.exampleEn: Mr Potter, this is Mr Jackson.
patterns.explanationUz: Rasmiy vaziyatda familiya oldidan Mr/Mrs/Ms qo'shiladi. Avval kimga tanishtirayotganingizni aytasiz, keyin kimni.

patterns.formula: O'ZINI TANISHTIRISH: I'm + TO'LIQ ISM, but please call me + QISQA ISM.
patterns.exampleEn: I'm Gillian Jones, but please call me Gill.
patterns.exampleUz: Men Gillian Jones, lekin meni Gill deb chaqiravering.

patterns.formula: PROFIL (3 gap): This is X. He's/She's from SHAHAR, MAMLAKAT. He's/She's YOSH years old and he's/she's a/an KASB.
patterns.exampleEn: This is Mary Stuart. She's from Dublin, Ireland. She's thirty years old and she's an English teacher.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu Mary Stuart. U Dublindan, Irlandiyadan. U o'ttiz yoshda va ingliz tili o'qituvchisi.
patterns.explanationUz: Unit 1 ning yakuniy qolipi — barcha o'rganilgan narsa shu uchta gapda. Yozma ishda ham shu ishlatiladi.

patterns.formula: O'ZI HAQIDA: Hello! I'm X. I'm from ... . I'm ... years old and I'm a/an ... .
patterns.exampleEn: Hello! I'm Rashid Al Hibb. I'm from Alexandria, Egypt. I'm sixteen years old and I'm a student.
patterns.exampleUz: Salom! Men Rashid Al Hibb. Men Aleksandriyadan, Misrdan. Men o'n olti yoshdaman va talabaman.
patterns.explanationUz: Yuqoridagi qolipning birinchi shaxsdagi varianti. Farqi: he's/she's o'rniga I'm.
